wikipedia#13.title: 1809: Napoleonic Wars: In the Bay of Bengal, a squadron of French frigates captured three ships carrying recruits for the armies of the East India Company.

wikipedia#14.title: 1583: The siege of Godesberg, the first major siege of the Cologne War, began.

wikipedia#15.title: 1210: Otto IV, Holy Roman Emperor, was ex­com­mu­ni­cated by Pope Innocent III after Otto commanded him to annul the Concordat of Worms.
